**Finding: Compliant (preferred position) — no redline proposed.**

I searched the full document for MFN mechanics (favoured terms, "no less favorable", best pricing, right of first refusal / match, third-party offers) and read every substantive section, including Fees (§ 3), Term/Termination (§ 4), Exclusivity (§ 6) and General Provisions (§ 10).

- **No Customer MFN.** Nothing obliges Deerskin to give HDI terms no less favourable than those given to third parties, to disclose better third-party terms, or to let HDI match an offer. Fees are a fixed 30% of Net Sales above an $11,000 monthly threshold.
- **The one favoured-treatment covenant runs in our favour.** § 1.8 binds HDI to promote the Site and Deerskin Products "no less favorably than it promotes HDI's catalog titles" — a Vendor-side obligation we retain, so per the detection guidance it is not flagged.
- **Boundary kept clean.** § 6.1's brand/channel exclusivity is an exclusivity term, not an MFN mechanic, and is left to that rule rather than double-flagged here.
